observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: an outdoor courtyard or dirt area with brick walls, trees, and buildings visible in the background, surrounded by a group of local spectators including children and men watching the performance
observation.dancers: one large black bear and its handler (an adult man), with another adult man observing nearby and child spectators
observation.formation_and_space: the bear stands and moves on its hind legs while tethered and handled by a man holding a rope and a stick in an open outdoor space
observation.posture: the bear stands upright on its hind legs with torso vertical and knees slightly bent when upright, or moves on all fours
observation.footwork: stepping side to side or bouncing up and down on hind legs in coordination with the music and handler's cues; precise foot placement cannot be determined
observation.arms_and_hands: the bear raises its front paws into the air while standing; the handler holds a rope and a stick
observation.hips_and_torso: the bear's torso shifts and sways side to side and up and down while standing upright
observation.partnering: the bear is tethered and guided by the human handler holding a rope
observation.levels_jumps_turns: the bear stands upright on hind legs, lowers to all fours, and occasionally sits down on the ground
observation.costume_and_props: the bear wears a red collar with decorative trim; the handler wears a brown tunic over a patterned sarong, a patterned cap, and sandals; the observer wears a light-colored shalwar kameez and an orange turban; a small handheld drum is played
observation.cannot_infer: exact footwork details, weight transfers, and subtle body articulations are obscured by low resolution and camera distance

signature_moments.what: the bear rises onto its hind legs from all fours and begins bouncing to the rhythm
the bear stands fully upright and raises its front paws high in the air while swaying
the bear squats down on its hind legs while keeping its front paws raised and upper body swaying
